subject: pathology
title: Reed-Sternberg Cells, CD15 and CD30, and Classical Hodgkin Subtypes

steps.tx: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma hides rare malignant Reed-Sternberg cells and their mononuclear Hodgkin variants inside a reactive sea of lymphocytes, eosinophils, plasma cells, and histiocytes that the tumour itself recruits. The binucleate owl eye giant is the **Reed-Sternberg cell**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Reed-Sternberg cells are rare giants in a reactive crowd they themselves recruited; find the owl eyes.

vis.caption: Reed-Sternberg pathology in classical Hodgkin lymphoma with reactive background.

steps.tx: Immunophenotype seals the diagnosis: Reed-Sternberg cells express CD30 almost always and CD15 usually, while losing the B cell programme despite B cell origin, with PAX5 only weakly retained. The paired markers are **CD30 and CD15 in classical Hodgkin lymphoma**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: CD30 positive, CD15 often positive, B cell programme silenced: that phenotype names classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

right.title: Nodular lymphocyte predominant
points: CD20 positive, CD15 and CD30 negative
Different therapy and late relapse pattern

steps.tx: Nodular sclerosis, the commonest subtype in young adults, traps lymph node tissue in collagen bands with lacunar Reed-Sternberg variants shrunken in clear spaces, favouring mediastinal masses in young women. The banded subtype is **nodular sclerosis classical Hodgkin lymphoma**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Collagen bands plus lacunar cells plus a young woman's mediastinal mass equal nodular sclerosis Hodgkin lymphoma.

vis.alt: Hodgkin lymphoma staging and Reed Sternberg cells
vis.caption: Hodgkin lymphoma Reed-Sternberg cells and staging framework.

steps.tx: Mixed cellularity carries plentiful classic Reed-Sternberg cells in a polymorphous background without bands, associates more with EBV and older or immunocompromised patients, and presents with advanced stage and B symptoms. The EBV linked subtype is **mixed cellularity classical Hodgkin lymphoma**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Mixed cellularity brings classic RS cells, EBV links, and advanced presentations more often than nodular sclerosis.

steps.tx: Lymphocyte rich classical Hodgkin scatters rare Reed-Sternberg cells among overwhelming reactive lymphocytes in nodular patterns, behaving indolently and mimicking the nodular lymphocyte predominant entity it must be separated from by markers. Marker discipline separates **lymphocyte-rich classical Hodgkin lymphoma**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Lymphocyte rich classical disease mimics NLPHL; only the CD15 CD30 phenotype keeps them apart.

right.title: NLPHL
points: LP cells CD20 positive, CD30 negative

steps.tx: Excisional node biopsy is mandatory because needle samples miss rare diagnostic cells and architecture, while immunostains rescue cases where Reed-Sternberg cells hide among mimics such as immunoblasts. Tissue adequacy principle is **excisional biopsy for lymphoma diagnosis**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Never diagnose Hodgkin lymphoma on a needle core when excision is possible; the diagnostic cells are too rare.

nodes.label: RS cells plus CD30 CD15 phenotype

steps.tx: Prognosis in Hodgkin lymphoma is enviable: most patients cure with ABVD based chemotherapy, PET adapted escalation or de-escalation, and involved field radiotherapy in selected early disease. Response adapted strategy is **PET-guided Hodgkin lymphoma therapy**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Interim PET now steers Hodgkin therapy up or down; cure with least late toxicity is the modern goal.

rows: Short ABVD plus involved field RT or chemo alone
ABVD or escalated regimens by PET

steps.tx: Survivorship dominates late Hodgkin care because mediastinal radiation and anthracyclines bequeath second breast and lung cancers, thyroid failure, infertility, and cardiac disease decades after cure. Lifelong surveillance embodies **Hodgkin lymphoma survivorship care**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Curing Hodgkin lymphoma is the first half; screening its survivors for second cancers is the second.
